description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of character types used in a dataset. The chart contains ten slices, representing different categories of characters. These include “Virtual Characters” (light blue), “Movie Characters” (blue), “Teleplay Characters” (light teal), “Novel Characters” (teal), “Game Characters” (cyan), “Actors/Influencers” (light green), “Musicians” (green), “Writers” (pale green), “Artists” (pink), and “Scientists/Athletes” (light pink). A central, unlabeled gray segment is also present. The chart includes a legend labeling each slice. No percentage labels are displayed within the slices, and no slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding. The slices appear to be arranged in a roughly descending order based on their visual size, starting with “Virtual Characters” and proceeding clockwise.
